description: Team SINGULARIS is a team of passionate space enthusiasts and aspiring engineers aiming to turn innovative ideas into reality through technology, science, and collaboration.
summary:
ORBITAL COMMAND is an interactive 3D space mission design and simulation game that makes space mission engineering accessible through gameplay. Players take on the role of mission planners, making decisions about mission objectives, spacecraft, payloads, launch vehicles, and orbits while considering constraints such as mass, power, fuel, budget, and operational risks.

The project addresses the Space Mission Design Game challenge by turning complex mission-planning concepts into an engaging, hands-on learning experience. It introduces players to mission types, mission phases, engineering trade-offs, and the consequences of planning decisions through interactive gameplay and 3D environments.

By combining space science, systems engineering concepts, simulation, and game-based learning, ORBITAL COMMAND aims to encourage scientific curiosity, strategic thinking, teamwork, and problem-solving among students and space enthusiasts.
details:
How the Project Works

ORBITAL COMMAND is an interactive 3D space mission design and simulation game. Players act as mission planners and make decisions throughout the mission-design process. They explore mission objectives and types, select spacecraft and payload concepts, consider launch vehicles and orbital choices, and manage engineering constraints.

The project introduces important mission-planning factors such as spacecraft mass, power, fuel, budget, communications, mission duration, and operational risks. These factors help demonstrate how engineering decisions can affect mission feasibility and success.

Benefits and Intended Impact

The project aims to make space science and systems engineering easier to understand through interactive learning. Instead of learning only from textbooks, students and space enthusiasts can explore mission concepts in a game environment, experiment with planning decisions, and understand engineering trade-offs.

It encourages scientific curiosity, critical thinking, teamwork, strategic decision-making, and problem-solving.

Technology and Development Tools

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS
  • 3D graphics: Three.js
  • Backend: Node.js and Express.js
  • Real-time communication: Socket.IO
  • Data services: Firebase integration
  • AI capabilities: Google Gemini API
  • Deployment: Render

NASA Resources and Engineering References

NASA and JPL resources informed the project's mission lifecycle, orbital analysis, mission maturity, mission design, and visualization concepts. These references helped guide the educational and engineering concepts used in the game.

Creativity and Design Considerations

The creative approach is to combine space mission engineering with interactive 3D gameplay. During development, the team considered educational value, usability, engineering constraints, mission feasibility, gameplay accessibility, scientific accuracy, and the distinction between real scientific information and simplified simulation values.

The project is designed as an educational experience that introduces the reasoning behind real-world space mission planning.
